recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the strategic heritage plan team develop, in close cooperation with the Facilities Management Section, a handover procedure manual. This would ensure that the responsibilities, procedure and expected handover documents are clear for the strategic heritage plan team and for the Facilities Management Section. The goal must be to hand over the sections of the works from the contractor to the strategic heritage plan team and the United Nations Office at Geneva/Facilities Management Section at the same time.
